title: Signal Runner
summary: A signal runner that demands fast reflexes and precise lane movement to dodge red hazards.
instructions: Move with arrow keys or A / D. Dodge every red block.

overlay.startCopy: An endless lane runner. Survive the acceleration, dodge the hazard stream, and keep the run alive as long as possible.

help.title: How To Start
steps: Press Start Run in the center overlay.
Use Arrow Left / Right or A / D to change lanes.
Watch the lane pattern and dodge the red blocks.
If you crash, open Menu and restart the run.
tips: Try to keep the lane rhythm stable.
Higher speed means the same route is harder to read.

onboarding.title: Runner Setup
startSteps: Open Help to read the lane controls.
Press Start Run to enter the track.
Stay centered for the opening hazards and then react to lane shifts.
onboarding.firstGoal: Learn the lane rhythm and survive the first hazard stream.
